newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH YR/YR NOV CPI SEEN AT 18.7-18.8 PCT - KOLODKO.
newsitem.headline: POLISH YR/YR NOV CPI SEEN AT 18.7-18.8 PCT - KOLODKO.

text.p: Polish year-on-year consumer price index is likely to fall to 18.7-18.8 percent in November from 19.5 percent in October and be about 18 percent in December this year, Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said.
"Inflation November to November will be 18.7-18.8 percent and about 18 percent in December," Kolodko told a parliamentary committee discussing next year's budget draft.
He also said the average annual inflation in 1996 was likely to stay within the government target of 19.8 percent.
Next year's budget envisages that the average annual inflation in 1997 will fall to 15 percent and CPI December 1997 to December 1996 will drop to 13 percent.

The government initially expected to bring inflation down to 17 percent in year-on-year terms this year from 21.6 percent in December 1995, but revised it to 17.8 percent in its 1997 budget draft and later Kolodko said it was likely to fall to between 17.9 and 18.2 percent.
